notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue (bank 't' = rows a-e, 'b' = rows f-j). The picture draws rows f-j on the upper half, but the names are mapped by that convention.

Rail hole numbers are estimated from the image: red 5V wire at bp.1, black GND wire at bn.1, orange wire at bp.3, black resistor wire at bn.7. Each rail is one strip, so the exact numbers do not change the connectivity.
The button straddles the centre gap at columns 4 and 6. 1.l/1.r are taken as the upper-half (f) legs and 2.l/2.r as the lower-half (e) legs.

The orange wire joins the button leg in column 4 (4t) to the + rail, which gives the 5V side. The teal wire from pin 2 lands at 6b.i, in the same strip as the button's other upper-half leg. The 10K resistor runs from column 6 to column 9 in row c, and a black wire takes column 9 to the ground rail.
The black GND wire from the Uno is assumed to go to the second GND pin of the power header (GND.2). The 5V pin is used for the red wire.
The resistor value is 10k ohm, entered as value=10000. The built-in LED on pin 13 is part of the Uno, so no external LED is added.
